description_en: Queries the contextual logs of a specified log
description_zh: 调用GetContextLogs接口查询指定日志前（上文）后（下文）的若干条日志
kebab_example: aliyun sls get-context-logs --project ali-test-project --logstore test-logstore --pack-id 85C897C740352DC6-808 --pack-meta 2_MTY1NTcwNTUzODY5MTY0MDk1Mg==_3_0 --back-lines 10 --forward-lines 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetContextLogs

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the log group to which the start log belongs
parameters.help_zh: 起始日志所属的LogGroup的唯一身份标识
parameters.name: pack_id

parameters.help_en: The unique context identifier of the start log in the log group
parameters.help_zh: 起始日志在对应LogGroup内的唯一上下文结构标识
parameters.name: pack_meta

parameters.help_en: The number of logs that you want to obtain and are generated before the generation time of the start log. Valid values: `(0,100]`
parameters.help_zh: 指定起始日志往前（上文）的日志条数，取值范围为`(0,100]`
parameters.name: back_lines

parameters.help_en: The number of logs that you want to obtain and are generated after the generation time of the start log. Valid values: `(0,100]`
parameters.help_zh: 指定起始日志往后（下文）的日志条数，取值范围为`(0,100]`
parameters.name: forward_lines
